verdict.rationale: Muse has its own computer with a file system and terminal. Everything it generates is stored in your VM, where you can inspect, edit and download the files freely, so export is documented. It can also build artifacts such as trackers, interactive study guides and dashboards. However, no evidence specifically covers creating documents or presentations, or iteratively revising them on request. Missing for 10: explicit document/presentation creation support, documented iterative editing workflow, supported export formats, hands-on corroboration.
